items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Henry Allen's band with Brown and Nelson we were talking about... I used to call them, they just relayed, transferred us, and got us down there because we was very busy down there in Dayvan. Dayvan where we played that 25 cents dance down there

ctx.x: There's pictures in that Esquire book. Like you can see Nelson in there. I found it.
You see Howard up there with the dirt on?
